row.title: Put KSA-specific quality processes in place: NPC submission, terminology, PSMF and data retention, product information
row.statement: In KSA the MAH shall put in place quality system processes ensuring: submission of adverse reaction data to the NPC within legal timelines; monitoring of terminology use; retention of PSMF minimum elements while the system exists and at least 5 years after its termination; retention of product PV data and documents while the MA exists and at least 10 years after it ceases; and keeping product information up to date.

row.title: Include duplicate-detection information in the ICSR when the reporter may have reported elsewhere
row.statement: When the MAH is informed that the primary source may also have reported the suspected adverse reaction to another party, it should include in the ICSR all relevant information needed to detect the duplicate case.
